_about: The house robot: the only robot a generated carousel cover may show (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-05). Pass its reference photos to the image model as references so it stays this robot; scripts/post-pack/cover_scene.py refuses a cover prompt that asks for a robot without them. docs/CAROUSEL-STANDARD.md, "The cover card is a scene, not a slide".
krish: Either we keep to brand and have my brand robot doing these things if you insist on a robot every single time, or you're welcome to be more creative in your Higgs field generations too.
Make sure all future carousel covers that are generated by Higgsfield either use the branded toy robot or are more creative than just a robot doing something.
what_it_is: A hand-sewn felt robot: cream felt with grey patches, a blank dark visor, the stuffing just visible at an unpicked seam down its front, three hanging threads (lilac, butter and coral, one per section) and a mint seam ripper beside it (brand book v1.4, p.13; docs/CREATIVE_IDENTITY_UPGRADE.md, "The felt robot").
keep: Never stretch it, recolour it or redraw it as a different robot. In a generated scene it may do things, but it stays this robot: the same felt, patches, visor, seam and threads.
